claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.ProcesskMatchEnd_Normal (0x060050A7; metadata spelling includes the 'k') is a parameterless instance method with an exact 156-byte body and exactly one direct DLL caller. It initializes a selected-player local to raw -1 and scans raw player indices 0 through 7. For each index it resolves PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(index), skips when the object converts false, skips when Player.isSleep is nonzero, and skips when Player.CheckRight() returns false. On the first player passing those gates it stores the raw index and exits the scan. If no index was stored it returns. Otherwise, in exact order, it calls MatchMain.inst.SetAfterMatchBGM(index); Audience.inst.SetBaseCheerLevel(4); FACT-0081 Audience.PlayLoopCheerVoice(4,true); FACT-0079 Audience.PlayCheerVoice(6,4); and MatchMain.inst.ProcessMatchEnd_Normal(this.matchResult,index); then returns. FACT-0091 pins the sole direct caller at Referee.CheckMatchEnd IL+0x00A2.
